Automation: Rules reference · play automation in progress

You hold a familiar image in your thoughts and press it toward your companion as their attention begins to scatter.

Rules

Action
Reaction
Attribute
None — no roll
Target / range / shape
Self or one visible willing ally within 3 squares, immediately after temporary Dazed is applied.
Duration
Instant.
Equipment / acquisition
None.
Limits
Repeatable; pay the action and any stated costs each use.
Type
Magic / Recovery

Reduce the newly applied Dazed by 1, minimum 0. Existing and starred contributions remain. This does not recalculate action categories already chosen for the current turn.
